rules.name: block-git-push
rules.reason:
BLOCKED by Policy: git push is restricted to the repository owner only.

Command: git push

Reason: Only humans may push to remote repositories. Ask the user to push manually when ready.

rules.name: block-rtk-git-push
rules.reason:
BLOCKED by Policy: git push is restricted to the repository owner only.

Command: rtk git push

Reason: Only humans may push to remote repositories. Ask the user to push manually when ready.

rules.name: block-rtk-git-checkout
rules.reason: git checkout -- discards uncommitted changes permanently. Use 'git stash' first.

rules.name: block-rtk-git-restore
rules.reason: git restore discards uncommitted changes. Use --staged to only unstage.

rules.name: block-rtk-git-reset
rules.reason: git reset --hard destroys all uncommitted changes. Use 'git stash' first.

rules.name: block-rtk-git-clean
rules.reason: git clean -f removes untracked files permanently.

rules.name: block-rtk-git-branch
rules.reason: git branch -D force-deletes branch without merge check. Use -d instead.

rules.name: block-rtk-git-stash
rules.reason: git stash drop permanently deletes stashed changes. Use 'git stash pop' to recover.

rules.name: block-rtk-git-stash-clear
rules.reason: git stash clear deletes ALL stashed changes permanently.

rules.name: block-rtk-git-worktree
rules.reason: git worktree remove --force deletes worktree without checking for changes.

rules.name: block-rtk-find-delete
rules.reason: find -delete permanently removes files matching criteria.

rules.name: block-rtk-xargs-rm
rules.reason: xargs rm -rf is dangerous - dynamic input makes targets unpredictable.

rules.name: block-rtk-parallel-rm
rules.reason: parallel rm -rf is dangerous - dynamic input makes targets unpredictable.
